description: M4M network analyzers (M4M 20, M4M 30, M4M 32, M4M 2X), Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP
source: ABB, "Modbus protocol map for M4M network analyzers" v.1.3G (9AKK107492A7627) and "M4M Network analyzers Modbus manual" 2CSG445050D0201 [V.1.05]

sources.title: Modbus protocol map for M4M network analyzers

notes: ABB M4M 20, M4M 30, M4M 32 and M4M 2X network analyzers; the product column of each register says which models have it.
Addresses are as sent on the bus. FC03 reads, FC16 writes. Multi-register values are big endian, high word first.
Quantities a model does not have read as "invalid": all FFFF for unsigned, the largest positive value for signed.

Logs, energy snapshots, load profile and max/min demand are read through request headers and data blocks; the indexed configuration tables (I/O, alarms, tariff programs, historicals) are set per channel. Both are described in the manual and left out here.
The powers without decimals (from 0xCB1A) need firmware P1.3.10.0 or newer, as does the M2M-compatible table from 0x1000 (not in this map).
Settings that belong together (CT and VT ratios, RTU settings, date and time) are written in one request.
